description: From PR #98 gating audit residual: handle_existing_cluster only bootstraps the system shard and never populates data-shard shard_materializers — so after EVERY epoch change, all data shards go placeholder + on-demand re-recruitment (cold-start latency per recovery), and previously-running data-shard materializers are left behind (potential mass orphaning as new recruits replace them). Pre-Phase-A this manifested as the original uncovered-gap behavior. FDB analogue: storage servers rejoin and are re-adopted. Design: recovery (or the Distributor sweep) should re-lock/re-adopt still-running materializers into coverage rather than recruiting fresh. Relates: bedrock-q67.11 (orphan reconciliation), bedrock-22g (thundering herd — every epoch change currently triggers herd conditions on first reads).

comments.text: Design per user 2026-07-15: FAST, non-blocking re-adoption. Recovery stays untouched. The distributor sweep publishes placeholder coverage IMMEDIATELY (unchanged), then asynchronously attempts re-adoption for uncovered tags with known candidate workers: consult the director's services map for kind==:materializer workers, query each candidate's shard identity + health via a single short-timeout info call, epoch lock/unlock (skipping worker creation), then deliver the adopted pid through the same path recruitment_complete uses (upgrading the slot from placeholder to real pid). Failure at any step = stay on placeholder, demand-driven recruitment as fallback. If no worker->shard mapping exists yet, add shard_id to materializer info facts (small).

Implemented on feature/q67-readoption (9ee26266), draft PR #102 into feature/q67-phase-a. Sweep fast path unchanged; re-adoption fires once after sweep_complete :ok (ordering placeholder->real guaranteed). Distributor now receives director's services map via child_spec; candidates queried for new :shard_id info fact (olivine + basalt) concurrently under 2s hard deadline; Recruitment.readopt reuses lock/unlock seams, unlocks at worker-reported durable_version, delivers via recruitment_complete path (monitor, placeholder_tags removal). Failures leave placeholder, no retry/backoff; pending_demands reservation closes the double-coverage race both directions. Foreman.new_worker gained params: so recruitment records shard_id in worker manifests. 7 unit + 1 integration test (refute create_worker, real olivine); full suite green x2; credo --strict + dialyzer clean. Awaiting gating audit.

title: Warm-cluster recovery re-covers all data shards via placeholder instead of re-adopting running materializers
